description: a stern woman knight with dark hair to the shoulders, dark steel plate armour with golden trim, a dark blue tabard with a belt, a tall kite shield with a tower emblem on her left arm and a flanged mace in her right hand, seen from the side, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
